short_original_excerpt: Specifies a target value that is ignored and does not contribute to the input gradient. When size_average is True, the loss is averaged over non-ignored targets.
equation_transcription: l_n=-w_{y_n} log(exp(x_{n,y_n})/sum_c exp(x_{n,c})) 1{y_n != ignore_index}; class-index mean=sum_n l_n / sum_n w_{y_n} 1{y_n != ignore_index}; sum=sum_n l_n.
inspection_note: Read actual page, not only redirect or a source catalog. For unweighted class-index CE, each nonignored position has equal coefficient 1/N; actual loss is still proportional to its negative log target probability. Official weight is per class, not per data source. The review source-weight example explicitly multiplies unreduced source losses itself and is not a claim about the API weight argument.
